items.Name: Territories and Urban Systems
items.Description: Design research at the scale of the region: mapping, scenarios and infrastructures for decarbonized and climate-adaptive futures, from the Great Lakes Megaregion to the Tennessee Valley.

items.Name: Responsive Envelopes and Material Systems
items.Description: Full-scale prototypes of building skins that sense, move and respond to air, light, heat and sound, including Stratus, Resonant Chamber, PneuSystems and Infundibuliforms.

items.Name: Buildings and Prototypes
items.Description: Building designs, competitions and full-scale building prototypes, from North House at the 2009 Solar Decathlon to visitor facilities at Notion, Turkey.

items.Name: Exhibitions and Installations
items.Description: Exhibition design, installations and touring shows, including EXTRACTION in the Canadian Pavilion at the 2016 Venice Architecture Biennale and New Brutalist Image at Tate Britain.

items.Name: Field Research
items.Description: Fieldwork-based survey, site analysis and planning, led since 2014 at the ancient Ionian city of Notion with archaeologists from the University of Michigan’s Kelsey Museum.

items.Name: Archive
items.Description: Earlier work, including houses, competitions and projects by the directors before RVTR, kept as a record of the lab’s history.
